school.name: Mott Haven Village Preparatory High School
school.overview: Mott Haven Village Prep (MVHP) is a small school based on the philosophy that it takes a village to raise a child, preparatory to success in college and careers. In June 2024, we became a Smart Scholars Early College High School, meaning that our students can earn up to 30+ college credits with Hostos Community College.  Our caring school environment gives students immediate and appropriate attention that supports personal progress and advances academic achievement. A challenging academic curriculum inspires students to rise above expected goals and reach for excellence. A committed and energetic staff supports this embrace of distinction. With 24 PSAL sports on campus, new clubs starting based on student interests and college classes with the National Educational Equity Lab, which partners us with the best universities (such as Barnard College, University of Pennsylvania, Morehouse College and Howard University, to name a few), there is something for everyone. For 2024-2025, we will have electives in observational drawing, Black History, Criminal Justice and Game Design. We are currently building a four-year high school to college program in Game Design.
